Method of Attack: Encrypts files and appends extensions (.Gamma, .Bkp, .Monro) to encrypted files
Drops ransom note FILES ENCRYPTED.txt with payment instructions
Typically installed via hacked Remote Desktop services
Uses ransomware encryption to rename files with email identifiers
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with Remote Desktop services
Attack Vector: Remote Desktop services connected directly to the Internet without VPN
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note file named FILES ENCRYPTED.txt
